disclaimer.title: What we will never ask of you
disclaimer.text: Our courses and our support are free. We do not sell visas or jobs and do not guarantee any outcome. We never ask you for money. Decisions belong to the relevant authorities and institutions. Always verify information on official websites.

mission.title: A human bridge between Cameroon and Germany
mission.p1: Born from a dual Cameroonian and German heritage, WAHHF Foundation (We Are Here Help Foundation) is the social and philanthropic branch of the IROKO Group.
mission.p2: Convinced that dignity comes through knowledge, health, and autonomy, we develop sustainable field programmes alongside a free German/English language and European orientation initiative.

education.title: Education
education.shortDesc: Tutoring, classroom renovation, scholarships and community libraries.
education.fullDesc: We work so that every child and young person has school supplies, teaching support and a decent place to learn.
programs: School kits and textbooks for pupils in rural areas
Academic mentoring and guidance after the baccalaureate

sante.title: Health
sante.shortDesc: Prevention campaigns, maternal and child health, access to basic care and awareness-raising.
sante.fullDesc: Working with local health centres, our volunteer teams organise free screening days, health education and support for mothers.
programs: Support for maternal and child health
Access to drinking water and hygiene in schools

entrepreneuriat.title: Youth entrepreneurship
entrepreneuriat.shortDesc: Solidarity-based incubation, digital literacy, micro-project management and mentoring by professionals.
entrepreneuriat.fullDesc: Supporting young people with local initiatives to build sustainable, ethical income-generating activities.
programs: Workshops on management and simple bookkeeping
Introduction to digital tools and office software
Networking with committed experts from the IROKO Group

environnement.title: Environment
environnement.shortDesc: Community reforestation, agroecology, waste management and climate education for young people.
environnement.fullDesc: Protecting local ecosystems and passing on to younger generations the practices of sustainable, soil-friendly farming.
programs: Village tree nurseries and reforestation campaigns
Awareness of waste sorting and urban sanitation

droits-inclusion.title: Rights and inclusion
droits-inclusion.shortDesc: Promoting equal opportunities, the inclusion of vulnerable people and access to civic information.
droits-inclusion.fullDesc: Defending human dignity by fighting every form of exclusion, whether social, economic or linked to disability.
programs: Empowering young women and community leadership
Helping young people with disabilities go to school

mobilite-langues.title: Mobility & Languages
mobilite-langues.shortDesc: Free German/English academy (A1 to C1) and transparent support towards 10 European countries.
mobilite-langues.fullDesc: A programme funded by our partners and donors, to learn German/English and prepare a study, training or mobility project safely.
programs: Support for German/English language courses from level A1 to C1
Active prevention of scams and false visa promises
